Catch items flying past you as you speed down different immersive environments.
Trigger multipliers with consistent streaks for the best score.
Glory goes to those who grab the most!

title: The Adventures of Mr. Fluffykins
description: Join Mr.Fluffykins on his epic adventure to find all of King Barts lost recipes. Explore Caves, Jungles, Frozen Tundras as well as the Wild West. Throw pumpkins, solve puzzles, shoot cannons, and join our royal kitty on an epic adventure.

title: Death Fungeon
description: A puzzle platform game, with both stealth and parkour elements. Use your wits, cunning and agility to escape this deadly prison. Take the stealthy approach, progressing slowly, hiding and staying out of sight. Or utilise your athleticism to wall jump, ledge grab and speed run your way to freedom.

title: Jump and Run: Don't Fall
description: Jump and Run: Don't Fall is a simple but challenging first-person platformer .

title: Clone Adventures
description: Clone Adventures is new type of 2D platform games with a fresh approach to gameplay. Try to control a whole lot of clones and have complete level.

title: In Your Realm
description:
In Your Realm gives an old-school, challenging, RPG roguelike experience with randomized
encounters and a unique combat system.
To beat the game the player needs to plow through every weakness of their personality -
represented in the game as bosses in their respective worlds.

title: Mendel
description: Mendel is a chill sandbox game about growing weird plants from alien genetics.

title: Fly of butterfly
description: Fly, butterfly, fly. Relaxing game for those who do not like stress and like when everything is simple and easy.

title: The Greater Good
description: The Greater Good is a full-blown, classic style turn-based RPG complete with an epic story, optional superbosses, world map, airships, NEW GAME+, and more. Stylized 3D graphics and a unique electronic soundtrack make it look and sound like no other game.

title: Construction Truck Simulator
description: Drive over 15 vehicles, operate large cranes and machines, complete easy and complex objectives and explore an open world environment.

title: Adventure Portal
description: Adventure Portal is a platform that allows players to connect and run their pen and paper role playing campaigns online!

title: Free Throw
description:
A simple game in which you only have to click the screen with your mouse.
There are several unique levels.

title: Brothers in Arms: Kill to Survive
description: Dogs of War: Kill to Survive - A game about the war, where you will play as an ordinary soldier. You will face all the horrors of the war and feel how it is to fight in a modern war.

title: Les 4 Alice: Lorange Journey
description: 3 connected short stories, written in Ren’py, with choices and various endings. Alice Lorange, a young autistic teenager, finds herself trapped against her will in a mysterious house.

title: VR Jogger
description: Get started on the trail to a healthier you with VR Jogger today!
Collection of jokes.

title: Contingency
description: Contingency is a fan made halo game that aims to bring the experience of the beloved series to the PC. We're not a copy of Halo 3, we're not an official Microsoft/343i subsidary, we're just a collection of halo fans who want to pay homage to the series. Here's the breakdown:

title: Doggo Dig Down
description: Dig down, build up in this casual crafting game about a dog looking for the perfect place to bury a bone.

title: Son.Light.Sleepwalker
description: Turn out the lights, pull up your sheets, don your headphones, and brace yourself for a most memorable, frightening experience. You have a sleepwalking 9 year old son. His psychologist said to never let him awake while sleep walking. Use your Smart Home cams - but don't let him into the light!

title: Grim Earth
description: The Earth's looking a bit Grim, but so would you after 5000 years and countless alien invasions! Grab your spacesuit (the air's not so great any more) and go for an adventure in what is still a beautiful world.

title: Inevitable VR
description: See if you have what it takes to solve the puzzles within game to enable you to retrieve, take control and bring the space station back to a stable condition whilst under pressure.

title: Galaxy Top Wing
description: This is an independent development of casual games, is the experience of virtual reality space shooting game. The player flying in the universe and sitting in the cockpit and observing the magnificent cosmic scenes outside the fighter by the VR, through the meteorite zones chasing and shooting with the enemy fighters in space with their teammates and attacking the enemy's spaceship. Follow up plans also develop planetary exploration, Galaxy roaming, and spaceship wars.

title: Divine Miracle Defense
description:
Divine Miracle Defense is an tower defense game with an magic theme and few roguelike which make it very unique.

You have to build an defense line with mages and upgrade them to stay alive as long as possible. when you die, you get a few special points depending on how long you survived. With this points you can upgrade the power of your mages and many other things to stay longer alive.

title: Ambition
description: Ambition is a 2D strategy RPG game that explores a village with teleporters to dangerous dungeons. In this strange and quirky world, battle bosses like a one-eyed turtle with a fancy tophat, a giant centipede that lurks quietly in the desert, and many more!

title: Zniw Adventure
description: Zniw Adventure is a 2D, traditionally animated point and click adventure game with educational content, starring a young, yellow, female dinosaur having all sorts of adventures in the prehistoric land of Polisemia.

title: Port Valley
description: Port Valley is a (not so) classic Point & Click game where a certain choice changes everything. Witness 3 points of view of the same story and find out what's really going on during Port Valley's Election Day!

title: Marbledrome: Crazy Stunt Balls
description:
Original game system, novel, fun and different from any game of racing balls.
Compete against other players from around the world to get the best time on each track.

title: My Holiday
description: 画风清奇的RPG作品，故事讲述的是一个小学3年僧，随父母回老家的5天假期生活。在老家的小区你会遇到一群性格各异的小盆宇，展开一张并不是很激烈的假期冒险。

title: Never Breakup
description: This is a two-player game where two players are connected by a rope and they need to work together to pass the level. The game includes both action and puzzle, challenge your skills and brain. It should be noted that no matter what the outcome is, don't break up with your partner!

title: Cash Rush
description: Cash Rush is a Shop Game simulator. Create your business from scratch, use decorations to increase your margin, hire new employee and start making the billions you deserve!

title: ABC Paint
description: A VR drawing app as easy as ABC. No clever hologram-menus or impressive lazer-pointer interactions - just You, the brush, palette and an endless canvas. Suitable for any age.

title: Concord
description: In Concord, you play as the crew of the Northstar—a group of guns-for-hire known in our galaxy as Freegunners. The Freegunners roam the stars taking high-stakes jobs on worlds across Wild space, where they face other fiercely competitive Freegunner crews. From match-to-match, you’ll form your team of Freegunners with other players and battle it out with rival crews to take home the reward across a variety of maps and modes.

title: Bottle of truth
description: Узнайте историю простого русского парня, который живет в России. Возможно он хотел бы никогда не покидать свое комфортное убежище и не видеть все ужасы улицы, но судьба уготовила ему совсем иные планы и ему предстоит увлекательное приключение.

title: Farjob
description: Delve into a boundless realm of twisting pathways and absurd bosses.

title: Velocity G
description:
Velocity G is a futuristic Zero G, 360 degree tunnel racing game set in the year 2086.

Experience incredible high speed action as you race your way across exiting tracks, each with their own unique characteristics.

Play single player against AI, split-screen with up to 4 players, or offline versus ghost players from all over the world!

title: Eight.Domino.Heart
description:
Eight.Domino.Heart is a logic puzzle game of dominoes 🁬 🁶 🁼
Use your wits to fit every domino together and fill the board!

title: Age of Forays
description: Feel yourself in the role of warrior. Do raids, improve your ship, improve your hero, control your combat unit. Become a part of the great history of the northern kingdom

title: Acid Nimbus
description: manage your ammunition and dodge projectiles. Charge with your bayonet and get the highest score.

title: LoveBug
description: Sleepless nights. Blood, sweat and coffee. Survive your first game jam while developing a game in just under a weekend and maybe, just maybe, in the end of this all, you will find true love!

title: A.D.M: Angels, Demons and Men
description: Angels,Demons And Men(A.D.M) is a difficult apocalyptic hack n slash RPG.Explore the worlds for clues and collect required items.Master combat skills and learn god-like spells,slay various demons and prepare to save the world.

title: Amulet Zero: Optimize
description: 某一天，一觉醒来的朵琳，发现自己正置身于这个陌生的小岛上， 独自在树林里走着，没走多远，她遇上了一个哭得很伤心的女孩子，她叫杰西卡……

title: Touch Type Tale
description:
A boy is wanted for his nimble fingers by four rivaling dukes and duchesses of a kingdom in turmoil.

Touch Type Tale is a real-time strategy typing game featuring a story rich campaign and online competitive play.
Challenge your friends in a battle of tactics and typing skills!

title: Pixel Draw
description: Color by Number - Pixel Draw is an addictive anti-stress pixel art game. Choose from a variety of fun pixel images and follow the numbers to bring them to life. Pixel Coloring has never been this easy!

title: Cortex
description: Cortex is a little puzzle game containing over 200 levels!

title: Chicken VR
description: Chicken VR is a virtual reality first person chicken simulator. You can teleport around and explore, eating food, drinking water, and laying eggs.

title: Fortified Swiss
description: Fortified Swiss is an immersive tower defense experience featuring a grand campaign that spans across the continent of Fromage. Vast hordes of mice have invaded due to the Mouse King's insatiable desire to hoard the most artisan of cheeses.

title: Tech Corp.
description: Tech Corp. is a game where you try to become the biggest tech company in the world . Your goal is to become the next big shot in the tech industry. The game also takes place through history. Starting in the early 90's and going to present time. You're in charge of creating and designing new Products such as Consoles, Phones, Tablets, and Computers. You are responsible for all aspects of a product from the software, the manufacturing, and the releasing and marketing.

title: Crackpot Despot: Trump Warfare
description:
Your mission is to help reunite Don Flan make it across the border to reunite with his family after being forcibly separated from them under Trump’s disastrous new immigration policy! But it won’t be an easy feat. First you’ll have to make it past Trump’s Border Wall defenses.
Don't miss out on this Presidential Parody of Epic Proportions!

title: Stay or Leave
description: This is an adventure ARPG with great sense of blow.You can collection of stones,wood and straw etc to make the props or equipment you need.You can also take care of the plants of the camp to get food.Maybe you can go fishing quietly,just forget the whole world...Give full play to you!

title: Brick Breaker with Risa
description: Remake of classic Brick Breaker game with level editor and a cute anime girl guide who will make comments about your game-play.

title: Goalkeeper Legend
description: Fulfill your dream of playing as a goalkeeper in the biggest football tournaments!

title: Shudder
description: Shudder is a high speed, twin-stick shooter with one stick and no shooting. Lost in an interdimensional wormhole, absorb powerful cosmic cells to charge up the awesome power of the SHUDDER Drive 9000TM and use it against the onslaught of interstellar Para-Bugs. Shatter Vortex-Cubes and decimate the bio-organic threat to rack up high scores and harvest rare resources to unlock more powerful ships and increase your chances of survival.

title: Urban Lockdown
description: Side scrolling beat em up game featuring digitized characters and a blood soaked action adventure

title: Slay the Dragon!
description: Maj must traverse a fantastical landscape and overcoming mighty foes, in order to rescue her younger brother from the clutches of an evil dragon. "Slay the Dragon!" is an isometric hack and slash game inspired by old school adventure games and the Swedish countryside.

title: Holiday Escape
description: Holiday Escape is a casual game in which you play a snowman trying to outrun a large snow ball while grabbing as many ornaments and presents as possible to spread holiday cheer.

title: Bunny: The Horror Game
description: There is a terrible bunny in the house.

title: Memetown USA
description: Memetown USA is a short game about saving the world from a dangerous church trying to destroy the universe. Memetown USA may be small in scope, but it makes up for it with intense AAA quality meme material.

title: King of my Castle VR
description:
King of My Castle Vr is a Medieval Cartoonesque Tower Defense in which you will play an archer who must defend the King's Tower. 
 
You can teleport to 5 different locations to defend the city. 
 
A game for the whole family and guaranteed archery sensations!

title: Paws and Soul
description: Paws&Souls is an adventure game about reincarnation. Turn into a wolf, explore a mysterious forest and reveal every secret of your past life!

title: Evemnesis
description: For many years you have been an excellent worker for the system. You have retrieved countless relics and faced hundreds of meaningless challenges. But every explorer has one last mission. You are starting to realize that your final quest inside the cyclical structure is near.

title: Ducks and Gooobers
description: Ducks and Gooobers is a simple Tower Defense game with unique features and gameplay. You can choose between different unique towers and blocks to fight off over a dozen different enemies. Synergy between tower and block will be key to surviving the longest.

title: Unexpected Circumstances
description:
Use WSAD keys to move and mouse to look. It's simple.
Our fearless hero-androir get stucked into the labyrinth.You are to help him to find the way. You'll come across incessant mazes and you are to overcome it. You'll need a planty of patience to find the way out and don't die on your way. Good Luck on Your journey!

title: Escape: Secret of the Hidden Room - The Collaborator
description: a room escape adventure game that will touch your heart

title: Fruit Tower Defense
description:
Fruit Tower Defense is a strategy video game consistsing of 15 levels across 5 worlds, with each world hand-drawn and designed by a different artist, giving each world a unique feel.

Fruit Tower Defense is ad free and does not contain in-game purchases.

title: SpaceBall in Cube
description: SpaceBall in Cube is a game for those who want to relax from shooters, racing, arcade, etc. The game is suitable for people who like to play the argument, since the idea of the game is to recruit space spectacles. One more name to represent the game - cosmic bowling in the cube.

title: Savage Vessels
description: Rogue-like 2D space shooter with pixel-art, physics and hard survival.

title: Tiger Fighter 1931
description: This is a shoot em up game. In this game the player combats a large number of enemies by shooting at them, the game is set in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression off the air of the North Eastern Province.

title: Adome
description:
ADOME is sci-fi action, platforms and first-person exploration in which history has great weight.
Thanks to the elaborate parkour system, you will enjoy an agile gameplay with fast and dynamic fights.

title: WASDead
description: WASDead is a hardcore action platformer where you assume control over the character R in his quest to collect MONEY. Why? Because money makes you feel good!

title: Poltergeist Treasure
description: Poltergeist Treasure is an absurdist comedy point & click adventure game following Sir Typhil of Creulor as he attempts to escape a haunted forest.

title: Garrison Gauntlet
description: Garrison Gauntlet is an oldschool-style action-platformer where you play through over four stages of intense challenges! A little robot that is to serve as nothing more than as one of the many robotic minions owned by the evil tyrant, Garrison, it realizes that being in such a position is no rewarding task. As the robot itself, you must stop Garrison's forces from the inside before they take over the world!

title: Torn Asunder
description: Tear off their limbs, use them as weapons, conquer the environment, destroy the primevals, SURVIVE THE ONSLAUGHT.

title: Caramba
description: In this game, you have to train your memory and find the treasures of the captain.

title: Kitten and Food: Adventure Park
description:
Help to collect all the food for a gluttonous cat. Beware of collision with all kinds of obstacles in the form of birds, stakes and high-rise buildings.
The game features 60 levels with two bonus, excellent graphics and fun background music. Play and have fun with the game.

title: Battle Royale Simulator
description: Battle royale simulator lets you simulate and control a battle royale game. You can choose the amount of player (like 600 at max), game speed, air drops, where the storm will close and just some really cool things

title: The Wanderings Dragon
description: The game takes place in the distant past, when the dragons lived on the ground, and people hid in the castles...

title: The Odd Battle
description: A sarcastic fight game about the world with the world.

title: Mahjongg The Ultimate Collection 2
description: The ultimate collection of Mahjongg games features 15 game variations, 30 tile sets, 150 backgrounds, and 125 tile layouts.

title: Fred the Fraud
description: This is an adventure based game with multiple levels and made to keep the player happy and not raged. This game is a game about a person named Fred who has deceived his fried Joe, and in order to complete the game the player must make the right decisions to make everyone happy or you can just stuff up their lives lol.

title: Prank Masters
description: A romantic comedy otome visual novel game where you play as a heroine prankster.

title: Drymir Cave under Richmordnom
description: Drymir Cave under Richmordnom is a hardcore indie project and RPG elements, with a third-person view. Events which unfold in a small area, not far from the native village of the main character.

title: BattleBlade
description: BattleBlade is a 2D Fighter game with Bullet Hell elements featuring a story-based campaign about Gods and Demons fighting for Earth. Read visual novel style dialogue to discover the truth! BattleBlade also features a local multiplayer versus mode allowing you to battle your friends!

title: Swamp Jump
description: A puzzle game in which you have to collect fruits and berries on dangerous stones that go under water. Collect them all and try not to be trapped!

title: Land of Puzzles: Castles
description: In Land of Puzzles: Castles the king and queen need your help. To avoid war the king has accepted a challenge of puzzles to solve. He needs you to solve 15 sets of challenging puzzles and help him secure the kingdom.

title: City Blocks
description: City Blocks is a puzzle / deck-building game. Place city blocks so their pipes is aligned and earn new ones as you proceed through the game! A genre-blending game that removes micro management for a more puzzle-like approach to city planning.

title: Deadly Wheels
description: "Deadly Wheels" - simulator of the race for survival.

title: Test Subject 901
description: Trudge through haunting halls and desolate rooms, teleport through the darkness and hide in the shadows as you plan your escape. Feel your heart race as your doom looms ever closer. Find a way out before your fate is sealed.

title: Boom Bits
description: Boom Bits is a single-player shoot-em-up set in the distant future where humans have been forced to leave the planet. You must protect the cargo and get to the launch site.

title: Dojini
description: Dojini is a 2d platformer game where you control two characters at the same time. After the Dojini had his body and mind split into two different dinos after a wizard put a curse on him for eating his apples

title: Project Reset
description: Play as a boy who got back from a 1 month vacation and has returned to school, only to find that he meets 4 new friends, and gets into a new hobby! Meet all 4 of these characters in Project Reset, a free visual novel!

title: Boons Farm
description: A casual shoot'm dead endless waved zombie game, upgrade weapons and compete to get the highest score.

title: Polygone
description: Polygone is a low-poly, yet highly visual take on the classic "Zombie Modes" in modern first person shooters. Play with up to four friends to fight off endless hordes of over 50 different zombies and bosses on a massive map that you'll need to unlock areas to explore.

title: Pottis Dream Forge
description: Pottis Dream Forge is a text-based RPG that aims to recapture the days where untalented developers could publish a game and still be popular.

title: Aether Drift
description: Aether Drift is an Arena-Based Bullet Hell Arcade game with an emphasis on speed and intensity. Fight your friends in intense Multiplayer battles, or work together to defeat Mobius's army! The game's endless Arcade mode ramps up difficulty over time, and challenges and cheatcodes keep things fresh and exciting!

title: Midnight Ghost Hunt
description: A chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek game. Possess seemingly harmless objects as Ghosts or chase them down as Hunters before the clock strikes midnight!

title: Zettavolt Trigger
description: The security robots of Zettavolt Inc. have been hacked and are bent on tearing down the company from the inside out. Safe from hacking due to his A.I., it's up to Trigger to stop the rampaging robots before they ruin the fiscal year.

title: Gallows Choice
description: A classic for great fun, a virtual and improved gallows game!

title: Here Nya
description: The best game in the world!

title: Cyclones Playground
description: Perfection County has been destroyed by a massive amount of tornadoes. The N.D.P.T. S.W.D. has been sent to Study and stop the record amount of tornadoes.

title: Heavy Dreams
description: A boy. A laptop. A dream. In this game, you search through a young teenager's laptop, trying to find out his story. Solve hidden puzzles and read between the lines that he wrote in your quest to unravel the mystery of Jay Zhang.

title: Survivor in Summer
description: Try to keep 3 people surviving the plane crash

title: Joydoor
description: Joydoor is the main character who got to the world from which he needs to get out. You have to help him. In the game you are waiting for opponents who will disturb you - be careful, because you have only 1 life. You need to look for the keys to get out of this terrible world.

title: Misfit
description: In MISFIT, you control one of several cyborgs in a multiplayer shooting arena, battle over objectives, take down other players, and achieve victory.

title: Beast Modon
description: In this arcade style shoot em up that lets you earn more punishing difficulties, you are Sylvester, a hero pilot in his glory days turned space janitor on a space station. After an attack on said post, it is up to him to retrieve the fabled Fang Shards. Turn your Beast Mode on, you're going to need it.

title: Lucid Path
description:
Lucid Path is a dungeon crawler RPG with simple and pleasant game mechanics that focuses on progressing in a dungeon and upgrading your character 
 
Tired of your miserable life you have decided to set off on an adventure. Luckily for you, the village you have come across has a problem with a dungeon. Now you must only solve it... 
 
Features: 
  -Turn-based battles against dangerous monsters for their treasures 
  -Quests and work that can be done by playing one of five different mini games 
  -Many different weapons, armors and spells 
  -An interesting story 
  -A talking Cactus!

title: Legend of Assassin: Egypt
description: An exciting platform game about the adventures of an assassin in Ancient Egypt. Jump over obstacles and collect crystals, and try to survive in this adventure.

title: Sp!te
description: Sp!te is set in post apocalyptic times where nuclear war is going on throughout the globe, with zombies and monsters running everywhere! Sp!te is a wave based survival game. The waves go up to 25! If you can get to 26 you have beat one of the levels. there are currently 7 levels to choose from. all sorts of ammo, health and bomb spawns, and weapons to choose from throughout the maps.

title: Soul Rebellion
description: In the lands of Armelia, 10 people have been possessed by the soul of ancient heroes to participate in a evil game. Release your own soul in this Action-Adventure game.

title: Skywriter
description: Fly your plane and connect the dots with smoke trails.

title: Submerged: VR Escape the Room
description: Trapped inside a room filling with water, you will decipher secrets and tools to aid your escape. Hold your breath and dive for answers within a submarine deep below the ocean.

title: Special Warfare
description: Nintendo Switch Exclusive & High Quality Graphics! Experience a Middle Eastern battlefield in a sandstorm unfolding in gritty realism across a vast open field!

title: Happy Block
description:
A different Tetris game.
The color blocks falls from the top of the screen.
Move it to left or right,or rotate it,or adjust the array.
Take the same color block together.
If there are same color block more than 4 in horizontal
or vertical, they will change to gold coins.the big mouth will eat gold coins for you,Your record
will increase.
if you can't put the block quickly they will pile up. If it piles up to the top of the screen, the game will fail.

title: Touch Down Football Solitaire
description: Do you love football? Are you a master of Solitaire? Are you up for an adventure? Join the Solitaire City Juggernauts for the upcoming football championship and let the world know that you are more than a simple rookie! Master numerous levels of Solitaire, follow Frank and his fun story about the world of football and become the next champion!

title: Monster Farm
description: Here is a real farm monsters in which you have to grow your own monsters, developing them to more advanced creatures. Build the most profitable farm in the district!

title: Navyblue and the Spectrum Killers
description: Jump, Shoot and Dash throughout the city, choosing which crisis to solve first as you gain new powers and fight your way through legions of evil robots and thugs as you try to save the world!

title: Artificial Mansion
description: When Reuben inherits his uncle's mansion, the last thing he expects is to find are sentient life-sized dolls that are capable of moving and talking. As if that isn't shocking enough, one of the dolls is a psychopathic killer who has her sights set on him! Will he survive or become another victim?

title: Construction Charlie
description: Collect items and defeat enemies in this action-packed platformer! Construction Charlie jumps from between platforms over many detailed environments. Even after the main game is finished, a detailed level editor puts the power to create in your hands, allowing you to build your own experience!

title: Kentucky Robo Chicken
description: Help the Robo Chicken get the stolen light bulbs back!

title: Mars Power Industries
description: Congratulations on your first tiny colony! Taking the post of Plumber/Electrician must be tough out there, we know how lonely it might get and you probably miss your family. Don’t worry! We provide music. No silence in space. Studies show employees exhibit high degree of stress when surrounded by silence, so it is to be avoided. The pleasant soothing sounds of distant synth music will calm you right away… and continue calming you through the years… Imagine a spaceship slowly moving through endless black pudding, with no one on board but you and the lights. But the lights are broken. That’s the point – please fix the lights!

title: Nox Timore
description: Horror in dark hallways

title: Dasaku: Arisu to Kuroe, Musubareru Hi
FX-Unit Yuki: The Henshin Engine
description: Take control of Yuki and set of on a digital journey of pixel proportions! Get Ready for FX-Unit Yuki!!! 8 levels of hardcore retro action with Power-Ups, Varying Stage Types and Multiple Endings accompanied by an Amazing Sound Design.

title: Witch's Pranks: Frog's Fortune
description: You’ll be able to help yet another enchanted prince to reunite with his beloved princess Rapunzel, who was imprisoned in an inaccessible cave among waterfalls and her beautiful long hair was cut by the Witch.

title: Winter Voices: Episode 5 - Overflow
description: Deserts and river banks...That which was hidden has finally been unveiled. You walk along the rapids, sometimes on the road, sometimes in the forest-sometimes the current almost carries you along. You have one end of the thread, a beginning to your story-you must reconstruct.

title: Winter Voices: Episode 6 - Falls
description: The sun and the mist...You have reached the town, the first real town-and which town. Here your true voyage will start-here your road to the bay of sapphire will truly begin. There are so many things to prepare, so many things to accomplish before you can leave the mist.

title: Hello? Hell... o?
description: Hello? Hell... o? is a freeware horror game by tachi made in RPG Maker VX Ace.

title: Spring Flower
description: Spring Flower is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: My Little Pony: Friendship Gardens
description: Raise and care for your own Little Pony. Gameplay is divided between the farm, where you care for your pony, and Pony Village, where you can play games. Along the way, you can teach her to jump fences, play games with other Ponies, and eventually cross the rainbow to Ponyland. But don't let her rainbow fade away!

title: Umihara Kawase Fresh!
description: Umihara Kawase is an action game series where the player controls protagonist Umihara Kawase to reach the end of each level. The game is highlighted by its rubber ring action in which the player uses an elastic rope to progress.

title: Final Fantasy XV: Pocket Edition HD
description: Final Fantasy XV: Pocket Edition HD brings the chibi-styled, streamlined Pocket Edition to home consoles, condensing Noctis’s story into smaller hub areas with quests and enemy encounters. Combat feels more immediate with physical controls, and the HD version brings the pocket-sized presentation to PlayStation, Xbox, and Switch.

title: Extopia
description: 20XX. The world as you know it is gone. In its place spawned the land known as "Oasis", a so-called paradise in a world filled with chaos. Three major factions control the Oasis through manipulation of trade, military might, and tentative alliances.

title: How to Die in a Morgue
description: An Episodic 2D-Adventure for Windows and Mac

title: Starfighter: Infinity
description: A space based MMORPG with a focus on ‘dogfighting’ style action and exploration. Features a huge array of ships, imaginative weapons and ship upgrades with more being added all the time. Explore the galaxy, fight other players, form your own organisations, mine asteroids to craft new items, loot rare weapons from alien races, and more...

title: Iter Vehemens Ad Necem
description: Fellow adventurer, turn back while you can! For here begins the roguelike Iter Vehemens ad Necem, a Violent Road to Death. If you choose to travel along it, you will dive into countless exciting adventures to gain items of great magic, attain powerful equipment made of mysterious materials, bathe in the blessings of mighty gods and recruit loyal allies of various shapes and sizes. Unfortunately, along the way you will also often be dangerously injured, poisoned, catch numerous diseases, lose several limbs and transform into manifold different kinds of pitiful creatures in the darkest depths of hostile dungeons. And, at the end of the road, you are bound to perish in a most gruesome and painful way. Don't say we didn't warn you.

title: Syrup and the Ultimate Sweet
description: In a magical town there lives a candy alchemist, Syrup, who one day discovers a candy golem in her basement. Where did she come from? Who could've made her? Go find out! Featuring a memorable cast of colorful characters and 10 unique endings. Your choices affect the story! Will Syrup achieve her dream of making the Ultimate Sweet, or will she meet a much more tragic fate...

title: NeuroSlicers
description:
NeuroSlicers is a highly tactical cyberpunk RTS that turns the genre on it’s head.

Focusing on fast, macro driven gameplay, arena based maps and a multiplayer driven narrative.
Control clever AI powered units.
Use powerful hacking abilities that allow you to manipulate the battle boards.
Spawn advanced weaponry and buildings that allow you to take over the network one data node at time.

title: Gladius VR
description: Gladius is an immersive VR sword fighting game set in ancient Rome. As a gladiator, you will choose your weapons, train against different enemies, and finally fight for your freedom in an epic battle against the mightiest warriors and mythical creatures of the time. Win the crowd and you will win your freedom.

title: Majula Frontier
description: The sky over Majula is turning black, the ground is starting to decay, and monsters are returning to the world, forcing a group of retired heroes to band together once more.

title: Tapioca Rider
description: Tapioca Rider is a 2D dessert driving game. Jump, accelerate, and occasionally reverse through 78 tracks of procedural love and hate. Complete them without crashing or landing upside-down to attain the purpose of all gaming: a score. Then drive through another 9921 tracks if for some reason that wasn't enough. Be you a Tapioca Rider?

title: The Escapists: Complete Edition
description: The Escapists: Complete Edition brings you the whole original Escapists experience including all DLC packs as well as Fhurst Peak which is exclusive to Nintendo Switch.

title: Holiday Jigsaw: Halloween 4
description: Prepare for Halloween with Holiday Jigsaw Halloween 4. 500 photos means 500 excellent puzzles and ideas for a happy holiday!

title: Necromancer Returns
description:
Necromancer Returns is a turn-based strategy game and sequel to the game Beasts Battle in which you assemble an army and fight hordes of enemies. Peace in a fantasy kingdom has been shattered by the return of the Necromancer – a creature of darkness that wishes to enslave all living beings. Assemble the best warriors from all over the kingdom and achieve victory in an epic conflict.

In the Necromancer Returns world, you travel alongside the princess of the kingdom, exploring new lands and fighting a variety of opponents, some of which may decide to join your army. Every creature possesses special skills, opening up opportunities for various battle tactics.

title: League of Light: Wicked Harvest
description: The League of Light needs your help solving another exciting case! Children have been going missing in the town of Blake’s Mountain in the days leading up to the fabled Red Moon. No one really knows what will happen on that night, but everyone agrees it can’t be good… Strange creatures creep through the shadows, and the citizens fear for their safety. Can you uncover the secrets of Blake’s Mountain and rescue the missing children in this spooky Hidden Objects Puzzle Adventure game? We believe in you, detective!

title: Boom Blast
description: "Bomb Blast" is an exciting platformer where players must reach their spaceship. The core mechanic of the game involves using bombs as the main weapon. Players can place bombs to eliminate enemies and destroy obstacles, allowing the hero to reach the spaceship.

title: Lawless Lands
description: Lawless Lands is an old-school role-playing game featuring a unique setting and innovative mechanics that allow players to delve into a dark medieval, low-fantasy world of epic proportions. Discover and destroy the darkness that has taken hold over these Lawless Lands.

title: Exo-Adventures
description: Join the exploration in this fast-paced space platformer video game. Take control of your astronaut as you explore and clear out sectors of hostile exoplanets.

title: Long Road
description: Constantly create their own records, get more money, unlock the vehicle.

title: One Jump Bomb
description: A simple but not easy one button platformer

title: Ephemeral: Fantasy on Dark
description:
Fleeting, yet beautiful. The world of darkness —

The main protagonist, Cloe (name changeable) lived in a secluded town. Surrounded by wire fences, it felt like she was trapped inside a cage.

Zombies were the only residents in that town, and she wasn't the exception. Many took their own life rather than to age away, but they were otherwise living a peaceful life. One day however...

As Cloe was hoping to see the outside world, she received an invitation. An invitation to attend a prestigious, diverse school only the most talented and skilled could join.

title: League of Light: Edge of Justice
description: Return to the famous city of Hamelin to experience a clever retelling of the mysterious flutist who saved the town from rats but was denied his rightful dues. Years later, the infamous flutist has returned to Hamelin, and now he desires revenge! Investigate the smoky spirits inhabiting the town and uncover the truth in this intriguing hidden-object puzzle adventure!

title: Tee Time Golf
description: Hit awesome shots and have multiplayer fun with your friends. Level up your golfer and get cool gear. Build amazing golf courses and share them with the world. Supports both VR and Non-VR.

title: Disneyland Adventures
description: Disneyland Adventures allows fans of all ages to explore Disneyland park, enjoy adventures based on 18 popular attractions, engage in 100 challenging quests, and interact with 35 beloved characters. Disneyland Adventures is your ticket to the magical world of Disneyland right in your living room.

title: Medieval Steve
description: Steve - a magic pile of armour - is destined save the world. Use your abilities in this fast paced side-scroller, to help you crush your enemies, collect gems and upgrade your character, making you stronger, faster and unstoppable!

title: Gunlord X
description: Gunlord X is a platformer action game with an emphasis on exploring huge worlds and blasting off enemies. This game features 9 stages of exciting 2D gameplay with over 45 unique enemy types. Blast yourself through giant landscapes, explore caverns and reveal all secrets!

title: Instant Tennis
description: INSTANT TENNIS, INSTANT FUN

title: Royal Jigsaw
description: Enjoy high-quality graphics, adjustable difficulty levels and ambient music in this customizable and relaxing puzzle game that is fun for everyone! Rotate pieces to fit them in special pockets, zoom in on smaller pieces with a magnifying glass, and choose your level of difficulty with puzzles ranging from 12 pieces to 300! Replayable and suitable for players of any age, Royal Jigsaw is a game the whole family will love!

title: The Ragdoll
description: The Ragdoll is a fast-paced stickman-fighting game where you can challenge your friends and strangers, but you can also play co-operative tournaments with them if you feel like it.

title: ColorFold
description:
ColorFold is a puzzle game that's all about folding and moving coloured ribbons - sounds easy, right? 
 
Move the ribbons in order to fill all checkpoints with the right color. Overlap ribbons, use barriers as a strategic advantage or use the mirrored ribbon, which copies your moves, to make it to the very end. Or use the new oneway-gates and tunnels to complete all levels. 
 
But I don't want to spoil it all - check it out for yourself, especially if you're into challenging puzzles! 
 
Features: 
 
- 150+ handcrafted, brainteasing levels 
 
- Beautiful dark mode 
 
- no ads 
 
- no microtransactions 
 
- universal app: buy once, play everywhere. 
 
Controls: 
 
- either use your mouse, the arrow keys or WASD to control the individual ribbons 
 
Happy folding!

title: Jetstream
description: Jetstream is an elegant and relaxing puzzle game where you soar amongst the clouds. Play through dozens of sculpted levels as you guide your plane to its destination. Jetstream has been designed to be a frictionless experience - it’s just you and the puzzles!

title: Football Heroes Turbo
description: Fight your way to the end zone using skill, strategy, and super moves to smash the competition. Collect and upgrade hundreds of unique players to build the ultimate football team. Get online and experience the most action-packed football game in the universe!

title: Pit Blocks 3D
description: Pit Blocks 3D is a cube-matching arcade style puzzle game where you manipulate falling bricks of different shapes and sizes. The goal is to stay alive as the speed increases over time – and to rack up as many points as possible before the pit fills up with bricks!

title: Flock of Dogs
description: As a team of up to 8 players, ride flying dogs riding a flying whale on a road trip through the sky.

title: The Warriorlock
description: Escape into a far-out fantasy adventure as a young and talented warriorlock, whose next mission will bring him to battle his own demons in this stellar, story-driven romp with heroic and hopelessly flawed characters steeped in a twisted tale of mind over madness.

title: JumpHead: Battle4Fun!
description: Dive into the collective fight!

title: Monster Minis Extreme Off-Road
description: Monster Minis Extreme Off-Road lays on the nitrous in a big way and gets some serious air off with retro racing that takes off-road in new directions. Lean and mean, this game puts you in the action fast and keeps you there.

title: DCR: Drive.Crash.Repeat
description: DCR: Drive.Crash.Repeat is a retro style, ludicrous auto-forward driving game with an amazing twist, and absolutely no brakes! Drive your way through tens of handcrafted levels (to the extent that each level has its own name), across different atmospheric worlds!

title: Epic Battle Fantasy 5
description: A turn-based RPG adventure, full of video game references, juvenile dialogue, and anime fanservice... and also strategic combat, monster catching, and tons of treasure hunting!

title: The Godbeast
description: Welcome to the City of Eternal Night. Take revenge on the villainous Council of the Hunt and rampage on your motorcycle through the moonlit streets in this stylish action game.

title: The Spy Who Shrunk Me
description: THE SPY WHO SHRUNK ME is a stealth game where you are a superspy armed with a shrink ray! Shrink enemies and feed them to paper shredders - or shrink yourself to get past enemies. Sneak in 1980's Moscow and sabotage operations in a stealth game unlike any other.

title: The Turdler
description: Have you ever wanted to go back and re-live life as a toddler? Here is your chance to be The Turdler you always knew you could be in this crude VR title that throws you the reins of mass destruction.

title: Meow Wars: Card Battle
description: Meow Wars is a cat themed card battle game with easy to learn mechanics and charming hand drawn characters. Battle your way through each challenger to reach Commander Catrat and free Claw Mountain from his iron fisted grip. Each stage introduces a new cat and card ability in a compelling feline filled story. Challenge your friends to a PVP duel or test your might against a global audience.

title: Take That
description: Light Western shooting game, can quickly play the core content even if you only got 10 minutes break. Other fun patterns are added to the game to help you kill time when you don't know what to play.

title: SpaceExcavators
description:
Anime Studio “Sanzigen” comes out with their own retro game!
“ID-0” has become a side scrolling shooting game on Steam!
Operate the I-Machine of ID0 to mine and discover new Orichalt ores!

title: Block Heads: Instakill
description: Shoot and double jump your way through fast, kinetic, and blocky action in this one-hit, one-kill FPS as you secure your score. With customization galore: skins, hats, outfits, guns, maps, music, so much that you can't ignore! Co-op map editing, need I say more? Oh, and there are active ragdolls.

title: Space Between Worlds
description:
Did you ever pay attention to the importance of space?
Space Between Worlds is a short puzzle game that expresses the concept of proximity and lets the player interpret the context and arc of the story.

title: The Real Laser Ball
description: The Real Laser Ball is a physics based, arcade, high score chaser with a progression system and a fetish for the 80's.

title: Road Doom
description: ROAD DOOM is an arcade bullet-hell with a cheesy story. You play as Road Warrior, the great mighty hero of the western lands. One day horrible beings invades your home, poking around trying to scavenge what they may find interesting. Road Warrior looses his temper, firing off his ultra mega lightning weapon of doom on the filthy beings. You become exhausted, weak, helpless... until your good buddy "Boat" arrives to re-supply your energy storage level! Determined, you move forward to push back the evil once and for all. A great quest lies ahead of you Road Warrior. Your determination and skill will be put to the test, as you fight against great beings of doom with powerful tricks. Save the world, defeat the Four Horsemen, charge!

title: Neko Dungeon
description: This is a game similar to Roguelike, which focuses on leisure strategy. There are lots of random maze and divergent story modes in the game.We need to help the lovely heroine escape from a dungeon, and at the same time, compete with your friends for a better score . Are you ready?

title: Astonia Reborn
description: Astonia Reborn is a Free-To-Play Classic 2D Isometric MMORPG. Astonia is based in a fantasy world that has developed its own lore surrounding a land where demons roam free, animals have gone wild and civilization is on the brink of a great disaster.

title: Donut Shop
description:
Enjoy this tasty puzzle game
where you match the donuts up to beat your family and friends,
maybe go it alone and score points before time runs out.
Play another tasty mode where you hold out as long as you can and drop long john on your friends,
or try to see how long you can go until you reach the top.
Whichever you choose will be delicious fun.

title: Patternis
description: Put your mind into solving patterns, swiftly traveling your way. Discover the rhythm of the solutions, becoming more natural as you go.

title: SRC: Sprint Robot Championship
description: SRC is a science fiction racing game which combines sprint racing with parkour obstacle running. With no speed limit, players attempt to achieve the fastest lap times possible. Players race across a wide range of tracks, each one offers a unique challenge to test players skills.

title: The Unbreakable Gumball
description: The Unbreakable Gumball is an open-world superhero game that takes place inside of a comic book! Jump, swing, and glide your way around the city of the future!

title: Glare1more
description:
Glare is a word entry type of game. Aim to clear it by inputting words or phrases found during conversation..
Glare 1more is a remake of the free game, Glare 1, and includes a bonus scenario.
If you enter the correct words and phrase during Glare’s conversation the story will advance.

title: Leder Panzer
description: Multiplayer tank game with a mad weapon arsenal and tactics, different levels and game modes, ballistics, nukes, napalm, bigger nukes, air and anti-air weapons and personified tank characters with special abilities.

title: The Beat: A Glam Noir Game
description: In The Beat you take on the role of Leo, a closeted cop investigating a murder in the gay community. Each choice you make has a meaningful effect on the story and the more drama you create the higher your score.

title: The Lift
description: You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.

title: Galaxy Champions TV
description: Galaxy Champions TV is a super intense top-down closed arena shooter game inspired by the classic arcade game Smash TV. Get powerful weapons, kill huge amount of enemies, level up, upgrade, find out your perfect build and beat all the bosses to become the champion of the most violent TV show of all time.

title: Der Milchbauer
description: The dairy farmer is a simulation application that enables users to take responsibility for a farm in a playful way. The user is required to economize, feed the cows, purchase and sell them, manage milk production and more to keep the farm going until the user’s retirement.

title: WEscape
description: In WEscape, a group of up to four friends put their minds together to solve puzzles and escape dungeons. Test your communication and reasoning skills while having fun with your friends. It's the essential experience of an escape room without the expense or hassle of actually going to one.

title: Rings of Saturn
description: The unexpected discovery of valuable minerals within the rings of Saturn has sparked a thriving space excavation industry. Experience hard sci-fi, top-down space simulator, with every aspect backed up by real physics and science.

title: Robot Wants It All
description: Robot wants stuff! Go get it for him in this compilation of the metroidvania Robot Wants series, including an all-new Robot adventure!

title: Just Beat Em Up : World of Fury
description: Just Beat Em Up : World of Fury is a "side-scrolling beat'em up" that brings you back to the golden age of arcade games. Fight alone or with a friend and beat up all your foes. Escape from the prison of the desert, chase after general Bombix and foil Iron Muscle's evil schemes. You will face many dangers through thirty different levels, all accompanied by explosive sound tracks.

title: Fragile Fighter
description:
You see no light in your shadow.
Scared to face your mirror.
In your self-reflection.
You find your peace... your protection.

title: Tok
description:
Tok is a game where you will have to solve a puzzle by connecting all dots with lines.
Hurry up, time is limited!

title: Metal Brigade Tactics
description: Metal Brigade Tactics is a turn-based tactical strategy game with deep RPG elements. Control your squad of Vertical Armor giant robots on a mission to stop a small country from embroiling the world in a devastating war.

title: Strike Cars
description: Become a participant of the crazy car battle tournament. Equip your car to the maximum and be ready to fight. Try to survive in this armored cars extreme race.

title: Gumstein: The Awakening
description: Solve puzzles and evade hazards using several interesting abilities such as sticking to walls, splitting, and launching your other half through multiple levels on your quest to find Ruby

title: Zombie Flick
description: It's a well-designed side-by-side action adventure game that allows you to control a single character, deftly destroying traps and heroically killing hordes of zombies along the way by executing gorgeous commotion, using a variety of weapons, and unleashing powerful skills.

title: Volcanic Blocks
description: Volcanic Blocks is a puzzle game in which you must destroy colored blocks by combining them.

title: Time Traveling Raptors
description: 16-Bit inspired action exploration platformer about a girl trying to fix the timeline while fighting off dinosaurs.

title: Survive in Angaria TWO
description:
Survive in Angaria is a mini RPG survival game.
Look around, chose your weapon, earn money and help people!

title: San Camillo II
description: Welcome to our lovely home, San Camillo II. Please, come inside and see for yourself the advances the institution gives to the children. Feel free to check every corner of the house. This guy? Don't worry about him, Vlad will only accompany you so you don't get lost. Just one more thing, be sure to arrive at dinner time.

title: Insurgence: Chains of Renegade
description: Insurgence is a 2D Role Playing Game with Visual Novel elements, Enjoy the classic RPG experience and discover the meaning of redemption and friendship within the Insurgence movement.

title: PlatBall
description: PlatBall is a casual puzzle platformer. Currently with 50 levels for chill playing or speedrunning.

title: Your Dry Delight
description: Set in 1920s Prohibition-era America, this romantic comedy follows Detective Richter and his adventures as he attempts to unravel Cleveland's liquor industry.

title: Rogue Party
description: Soul crushing bosses, epic loot and powerful magic await 1-4 Rogues foolish enough to take on the Dungeon of Doom.

title: Cat Inside
description: This is a puzzle game .Play as a orange cat to help the little girl escape

title: Nightmare of Melanie
description: Players will constantly experience their inner voice between the truth and fear from Ling's perspective, and face the most cruel fate hidden in the deepest darkness after the horizon is clear and swept by fear one after another...

title: The Legend of Protey
description: Step into the gooey metaphorical shoes of the least likely hero in gaming history, who must save his world from the greatest villain in gaming history!

title: Train Station Renovation
description: Welcome to an old, ruined train station. A place that will give you a lot of fun! In Train Station Renovation you play as a renovation company specialized in restoring old and damaged railway stations.

title: Cupids Love Crisis
description: Cupids having a rough day sorting through all of the positive feelings in the world. Help Cupid collect love hearts and power up his love arrows in this light hearted clicker style game. Tainted hearts will corrupt his arrows so protect him while he sorts out the positive love hearts.

title: Mist Survival
description: MIST SURVIVAL is a Single-player, survival stealth sandbox game Players will experience the Apocalypse stimulation in the form of virus pandemic, the players have to deal with it to survive through the difficulties such as finding shelter and food, threats from the environment and climate: wild animals, bandits, infected, and dense mist that can happen at any time.

title: Wolf: The Evolution Story
description: 'Wolf: The Evolution' is a simulator which tells a tale of adventure. Welcome to the Silverglade Pack, a small family struggling to get a foothold in the wilderness. You must help them to expand and grow until they can realise their dreams!

title: MiniMax Tinyverse
description: Lead your favorite Champion to victory! In this fast-paced Real-Time Strategy, become a God, cast miracles and command epic battles in a MINIature world. Fight 1 on 1 with players around the world! Who will crush the other first? The fate of your MINIs is in your God hands.

title: Crazy Alchemist
description:
* special note: this game also supports PC and VR two platforms,you can play it in pc without VR .

Crazy Alchemist is a simulation game full of medieval fantasy and magic.
Have your own alchemy studio, using a variety of novel raw materials to refine the amazing alchemy products.

title: Ranger in Spider's den
description:
Ranger in Spider's den - This is a dynamic shooter with a view from above, in which you have to destroy evil creatures. You are opposed by a swarm that will do everything to destroy you!
In the arena, you have to destroy first the crowds of monsters, before the queen appears, who will try to deal with you!
You are an elite soldier, on whose shoulders is entrusted a role, to save the whole planet from destruction!
In the fight, you will be helped by advanced weapons, which are easily dealt with monsters.

title: Super Strawberry Man
description: Super Strawberry Man is a 2D Old-school Action Platformer based on the biography of Strawberry man whose mission is to reinstate peace in the Fruitis City.

title: Paper Front
description:
Welcome to the "Paper Front"!

A new kind of classical tanks was embodied in an endless arcade.

title: Hentai Puzzle X
description: Hentai Puzzle X is a classic sliding puzzle game with relaxing japanese traditional theme and ambience.

title: Fatal Hour: Petroleum
description: Stranded at an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere, your mechanic is desperately trying to repair your transportation. There are no other humans in the area. Not living ones at least. Of the other kind there are plenty. And they're hungry...

title: HecatoncheirStory
description: You are a young monster hunter who moves between worlds in search of special prey.

title: Double Stretch
description: Double Stretch - an unusual top down flight shooter.

title: Infommi
description: Fight against a wave of monsters and bullet hell bosses with multiple characters of your choice that have different abilities to help you get to their Ultimate Master. Are you ready to take them on?!

title: War War War: Smiles vs. Ghosts
Evolo.Evolution
description:
Evolo.Evolution - an exciting strategy in real time with elements of the sandbox.
Go through several stages of evolution, from the usual rabbit, to the local ruler of these lands. Fight other sentient beings and build your tribe.

title: Awesome Pea
description: Help the greedy Pea to make his way through a string of levels filled with deadly traps and cute but dangerous enemies and collect all the coins to which he can only reach!

title: Hack the Core
description: A 500 words interactive fiction. Hack the Core connected to the bombs before they explode.

title: Piano Bar
description: Piano Bar is a music rhythm game where you come into the game as a professional piano player, who performs in a cocktail lounge playing jazz music to make a living. Play a perfect melody to catch a young lady's attention, and who knows, maybe you will get lucky?

title: Puzzle Master
description: Puzzle Master is a classic puzzle game with relaxing music.

title: What would Google say?
description: Do you know what Google would say? Do you think you know what other people think and put into their google searches? "What would Google say?" Is a quiz game where you need to figure out which of the answers is the top google auto correction and therefore which answer most other people put into their search engine. The premise is easy yet entertaining and sometimes you will be surprised what people are actually searching for on the internet.

title: Jar Battlers
description: Jar Battlers located in a toriyama-ish retro style pixelated world, where you have to get rid of your opponents using jars, bombs and more, in the numerous arenas of this crazy tournament!!

title: Lab.Gen.
description:
It is Labyrinth! No, a LOT of labyrinths which always will be different because of procedural generation.
And what about controls? They are simple. Left, right, up and down – that’s all you need to know.

title: Spellwake
description: Spellwake is an online 3D Action RPG where Anything Goes. It features fast-paced hack n' slash against hordes of monsters and powerful bosses. Spellwake's vast class system allows you to make nearly infinite variations of builds.

title: Jack Is Missing
description: Jack had always thought Kevin was his best friend, until the day he was murdered by him...

title: Galaxy Squad
description: Galaxy squad is a hardcore turn-based tactical game, inspired by FTL and XCOM.

title: Shahrzad: The Storyteller
description: Shahrzad - The Storyteller is a stunningly beautiful hidden object game with over 60 puzzles and minigames. Let the world of 1001 Persian nights mystify you!

title: Quirky Crystal RPG
description: A short 2-4 hour classically-styled RPG where you investigate the strangeness surrounding the guardian dragon's and their crystals. It also features a fun combat system where effects spontaneously occur based on your equipment set-up.

title: Sikanda
description: Sikanda is a top-down 3D Action-Adventure/RPG. The adventure takes place on a fantasy island named Galintrea and combines meaningful storytelling, a memorable character cast, and fabulous locations with beloved, old-school gameplay elements used in a fresh, new way.

title: Save the Girl
description: Embark on a thrilling rescue puzzle adventure in Save The Girl! You're the last hope to save the princess trapped in an ancient tower, held captive by fearsome monsters. Use your wits and strategic thinking to navigate treacherous situations and ensure her safe escape.

title: Land of Puzzles: Knights
description: In Land of Puzzles: Knights the king and queen need your help. To avoid war the king has accepted a challenge of puzzles to solve. He needs you to solve 15 sets of challenging puzzles and help him secure the kingdom.

title: Ball Run and Rush
description: Ball run and rush is a platerform game. You need to take all items to finish the game. Can you ?

title: Keyg
description: keyg is a game with very unique controls.

title: Blood City
description: Blood City, also called Demons Temple, is false God Dillas' rule site. The evil master who is Dillas' commander, could not bear the divergence in the sects, decided to escape Blood City.

title: Jellyfish the Ghost
description:
Classic 2D platformer with graphics drawn on paper.

You play for a purple ghost jellyfish.
Help her overcome all the obstacles to get home.

title: Knights of Tartarus
description: Knights of Tartarus is a retro style role-playing game that features strategical turn-based combat, exploration and freedom to customize your character.

title: Angel and Devil, Ninja, Sushi, Tempura, Panda and the Statue of Liberty
description: Shooting game to defeat the devil with angel's arrow.

title: Momo.exe
description: Horror game where you need to do different tasks from horror creature received by your phone. And remember: Don't chat with Momo!

title: Rescale
description: Rescale your ball to fit through all kinds of obstacles with the goal to never stop rolling. Change perspectives to better see over obstacles and find a way to resize your way past.

title: Sexy Jigsaw
description:

title: Kaleido Chaos
description: Have you played a game about "move the red block avoiding crashing with the blue ones", which flourished in the years around 2010? It was said that the game was one of the training programs for the pilots from some countries air forces. Kaleido Chaos is a little similar to that game but more flexible and playable.It is a game of reaction and attention, it can help people improve their concentration, reflexes and reaction time. In the game, player controls the Kaleido Cube to hit the right balls to get score and dodge the wrong balls to prevent losing score. To get high score, you need to be patient, calm, undistracted and with short reaction time --it is really a tough training rather than an easy game! If you can reach more than 600 score in 7 Colors Mode of INIFINITE, you must be a genius!

title: Stickman in the portal

title: Simple Racing
description: Simple Racing is an online multiplayer racing game. Play against your friends or with AI, either way fun is assured! All you need are your keyboard and mouse to play a quick race, since no controller support exists to level the playing field for casual gamers. Dozens of different races await your triumph!

title: Deepspace
description:
DEEPSPACE is an innovative Web3 strategy exploration MMO set in an expansive space environment. It integrates a sophisticated economy system using DPS, its native in-game token, along with NFT-based assets, providing players with genuine ownership of their in-game assets. The game is structured into multiple distinct stages, each offering a unique gaming experience, with The Hangar serving as the gateway to the vast DEEPSPACE universe.

Players in DEEPSPACE embark on a journey of purchasing, trading, and upgrading spaceships, fostering a dynamic interstellar experience. The game places a strong emphasis on exploration, inviting players to uncover the mysteries of genesis planets and various other aspects of its rich universe. The gameplay is diverse, ranging from resource mining to engaging in tactical battles against AI opponents and fellow players. Key features include strategic turn-based combat, the formation of alliances, and the expansion of territorial influence.

Operating on both the Ethereum and BNB Chain, DEEPSPACE adopts a gamefi model, blending gaming with decentralized finance. This model enhances the gameplay experience by offering economic incentives. The DEEPSPACE multiverse is a carefully crafted blend of exploration, resource gathering, and combat, ensuring an engaging and multifaceted experience for players.

description: Bomb Riders - a game in the bomber genre, which offers you a journey through an amazing world with many enemies, which can be destroyed by explosions and logic.

title: Jimmy Kamikaze
description: Jimmy Kamikaze - a game in which the child wants to swim in the water, but does not know how. You need to help the child do this by breaking the right blocks, so that the child slides down into the water. Avoid falling to the ground.

Venture out to engage in intense combat while exploring vast regions and treacherous dungeons. Explore the massive and lively world with your allies and friends. Or embark on an epic adventure alone and push your limits. From the weapons you wield to the skills you unlock, you have full control of your character's development and actions. Every choice you make in the world of Bless will shape your story. So forge your destiny and make your adventure go down in history.

title: Hamlet
description:
Hamlet is a first-person perspective game, set in the huge 3D maze-like eponymous facility. The auto-map is always visible, showing the player the character's position. Enemies and important objects are also visible on the radar. Whenever an enemy approaches, the playable robot is unable to move. The shooting is actually done in turn-based style; the player can only shoot once the robot's attack meter has filled up, and the rate of shooting depends on the robot's (or enemy's) agility. However, the game doesn't pause when the shooting occurs, creating the illusion of real-time combat.

Though the game looks like a first-person shooter, it is, in its core, an RPG. Player-controlled robot receives experience and levels up after having defeated certain amounts of enemies. Attack, defense, speed, etc. get increased with each level up. It is possible to find and equip various kinds of weapons: a basic gun with infinite ammo, but low damage; powerful rocket launchers which cause high damage, yet have limited ammunition, etc. Two weapons can be equipped in each hand, and the player can switch between them during combat. Shields can also be found and equipped. Weapon energy, body ("health"), and shield energy can be restored with appropriate items.

title: Rainbow Web 3

In the past, you defeated the wicked spider and saved the End of the Rainbow. But trouble has returned and a shroud of evil has settled over the kingdom! Will you lift the veil of darkness and rescue the realm?

Swap colored beads on a spider's web to create matching chains and release letters to spell magical words. Each match you make will charge your mighty hammer with a bit of rainbow dust. When your hammer is ready, it can smash any bead, allowing you to spell the words you need more quickly! Between levels, you can use your magic to release cursed objects and restore the town! Rainbow Web 3 can provide hours of relaxing match-three challenges and captivating casual fun!

description:

MoonStrike is a boiled down realtime strategy game, built for both Vive and Oculus Touch controllers (controllers required). Take over planets as fast as possible, build ships, and take over the galaxy!

If you can drag and drop a folder, you can play MoonStrike… I mean, badly… but still!

title: Space 2048
description:
Space 2048 takes place in outer space with grandiose visuals of the entire universe as background. Here you are surrounded by galaxies, suns and asteroids and move entire planets to get to your score. For an engulfing game experience Space 2048 includes a soundtrack and great sound effects. You can quit the game at any time and continue exactly where you left off later. There is an undo for any mistakes you might make and you always have a history of your last 8 scores available.

The rules for the Space 2048 game are very simple. There are only four game moves. Use the arrow buttons or swipe on the screen to move to the left, the right, the top or the bottom. All planets will then move into that direction as far as they can. Planets of the same kind will merge into a new planet with their combined value and your score is updated. You win once you have one planet with the value of 2048. And that is much easier said then done.

Visuals are a big part of the gaming experience and to match the overall theme all interface elements like the triple setting sound switch for example (full sound with background music, effects only or sound off) rotate floating in space. And while the true stars - pun intended - of Space 2048 are the planets with their magnificent slow rotation, they are more than matched in grandiosity by those fascinating backdrops. The latter are images taken by the Hubble Space Telescope with titles like "Antennae Galaxies" or "Ring Nebula".

title: The Wall: Medieval Heroes
description: Defend your village, which is besieged by aggressive, jealous barbarians. Keep an eye on your villagers, who will gather the resources you need to create your army behind the wall, and deploy your units strategically in front of it. With a wide variety of units, towers and traps to choose from, you will have to find the best ways of diverting, slicing, exploding, poisoning and incinerating an infinite army of aggressive, jealous enemies.

title: Flewberry
description: Flewberry is part pet-simulator, part action arcade game! Players are given a birb and asked to take care of it. The birb can go outside to collect items and see how high it can get. The collected items can then be used to strengthen and customize the birb.

title: Tokimeki Memorial: Taisen Puzzle-Dama
description:
Tokimeki Memorial Taisen Puzzle-Dama is a Tokimeki Memorial themed Taisen Puzzle-Dama spin-off game. It is followed by its sequel Tokimeki Memorial 2 Puzzle-Dama.

In the console versions, the player can unlock the secret characters, Rei Ijuin, Yoshio Saotome and Miharu Tatebayashi, as playable characters by beating the game on hard mode with every girl at least once. As for the arcade version, all 3 can be unlocked by inputting a cheat code.

title: Carpathian Night
description: Prince Dracula, Lord of the Vampires, has returned from the halls of Scholomance with the Army of the Dead at his back! Guide vampire hunters Abbot Dorin and Irina Dracul across the monster plagued countryside and into the heart of the ancient Castle Dracula!

title: Carnival Games
description: Carnival Games brings the party back for the entire family! With both fan-favorite and brand-new mini-games all in one package, Carnival Games offers fun for everyone and can be played alone or with up to three others. Hit home runs, pile the highest stack of cakes, and take your horse to the finish line. 20 total mini-games will have you and your friends stepping right up to win again and again!

title: Shooters Solitude System4
description:
Shooters Solitude is a classic bullet hell game in which the player pilots a small ship tasked with eliminating successive waves of enemies that appear from the top of the screen. Each level concludes with a challenging boss encounter.

The game's weapon system is based on a color-coded cross-grid mechanic. Defeating enemies of a specific color increases the power of the corresponding weapon, and the player can switch between weapon types at any time. A combo system enhances gameplay by allowing the player to gain additional power and speed depending on the combos executed. Movement is supported in eight directions using the keyboard, offering more control than the typical four-directional schemes. The game also supports joystick input.

title: Slam Dunk Typing
description: Now there's an exciting new approach to typing that combines the thrill of fast-paced basketball action with addictive games guaranteed to build typing proficiency. Learn the entire keyboard through 70 typing challenges, analyze your progress with customized stat charts, and put your skills to the test in a full-court All-Star Championship. There's even a coach to help monitor your progress and offer tips for improving your skills. Now learning to type is a slam-dunk!

title: Bite the Bullet
description: Satisfy your appetite for destruction in this roguelite RPG shooter where you must eat to powerup your character, weapons, and abilities. Consume strange species to add new entries to DarwinCorp’s mysterious Compendium. Catalyze crafting fermentations in your belly by eating enemies!

title: Trianthology: Sanmenkyou no Kuni no Alice
description:

A witch named Alice escapes boredom by experiencing three stories: Country Girl, High School Love Adventure, and Vespio 2438.

description: 3-D modeling application that includes a library of models from the Japanese anime series Mobile Suit Gundam.

title: Bladed Fury
description: An action game set in the Ancient China, bringing players addictive experiences with its unique Chinese traditional art-style and sound design.

title: ZDSimulator
description: ZDSimulator is a unique project of the real professional training apparatus for train driving schools, which is now available to any user as a railway simulator

title: Stealth Fishing
description: You are Frank the grey fox, an environmentalist and animal lover. You have broken into the largest freshwater tank at C-World, a marine animal theme park. Avoid the searchlights and rescue as many fish as you can before you get caught!!

title: Stranger Things 3: The Game
description: Explore through the world of the hit Netflix original series in the official game for Stranger Things 3!

title: Short Life
description: Choose your hero and get to the finish without losing your head :) Avoid obstacles and try to complete the levels with all your body parts.

title: Mega Quiz Gaming
description: Guess the classic and new trending games in the best quiz game with over 250 levels based on logic, deduction and your gaming knowledge.

title: Harlequin's Nightmare
description: "Harlequin's Nightmare" is an action/exploration 2D Platformer, that seeks to emulate classic 2D games. The game tells the story of a kingdom whose King is at risk of being overthrown by an ancient warrior who was loyal to him in the past, but due to his thirst for power was exiled and cursed, and has sworn to take revenge after his exile. The King has put the Kingdom's defense in the hands of the Order of the Green Harlequins, who have faithfully served the Kingdom for centuries.

title: Kisou Louga II: The Ends of Shangrila
I Wanna Be the Co-op
description: I Wanna Be The Co-op is a fan-made game online extension to I Wanna Be The Guy. This challenging platformer will push your skills to the utmost limits.

title: Khara the Game
description: Khara is an adventure story starred by a young girl who will have to find out who she really is. She will make use of her powers over water in order to face the many dangers that await her on the Atlantis Island.

title: Standby Say You!
description: Standby Say You! is a simulation game where the player takes the role of an up-and-coming voice director. The player character is the apprentice of real-life voice actor and director Shigeru Chiba, and is suddenly thrust into their first leading job as the voice director of a new anime series called "Interrupt Girl" after the original director suddenly leaves the project. In-game, the player interacts with the actors in simple adventure-style sequences, watches clips of tryouts, and gives feedback to each of the actors. The console versions also add several mini-games such as matching voice clips with the correct actor.

title: Harukaze Sentai V-Force
description: Harukaze Sentai V-Force is an isometric strategy RPG similar to Front Mission or Super Robot Taisen. The game follows Natsuki, Mizuki, and Kagetsu, three sisters who are pilots in the Earth Defense Force. Each mission allows you to configure your character's weaponry, and as they fight, they will gain experience and level up. Before and after each mission, fully-animated cutscenes drive the plot forward, and sometimes they will appear at crucial points during a mission as well.

title: Sotsugyou Crossworld
description: A visual novel game for the Sega Saturn, PS1, and PC.

title: Ruri Iro no Yuki
description: The protagonist of the game is a high school student who has lost his parents in a car accident. Living with foster parents was difficult, and he decided to rent the room in the house that once belonged to his real parents, feeling that their spirits will become closer to him that way. However, shortly thereafter the boy started seeing strange dreams. Upon his arrival he discovered a jar in a hole underneath the floor in his room, and that jar miraculously produced a young woman named Ruri (which means "lapis lazuli"), who becomes a part of his life in a way he would never expect.

title: Dungeon Dreams
description: Roguelike Romance JRPG. Customize your characters, take open-ended quests and write your own story in the town of Ecallia. A game with town building, dating and life sim elements, but also a randomly generated Dungeon with lots of companions and loot!

title: Slendrina Must Die: The Cellar
description:
Developed by Poison Games, Slendrina Must Die: The Cellar, is another Slendrina Must Die game which brings horrifying terror, a scary story and spooky graphics at every turn.

Game is based on Slendrina: The Cellar.

title: Beyond Perception
description: Beyond Perception is an experimental puzzle game based upon observation and space understanding. Use your mind and imagination to escape from museum paintings.

title: Keep Out
description:
Keep Out is a horror and mystery puzzle adventure Game.
A whole story of Keep Out is from Devota Hill in 2044. You are "Mr. M", the toy of a wise and benevolent monarch. Explore and Find Secrets of Devota Hill and HumathScience.

Players explore Devota Hill by manipulating Mr. M in 3D, Side-scrolling views.
