description: The Moment We Met is a galgame with the theme on warm. In the game, you will play the part of the hero named Mr. Heh, and share an extraordinary life with an adorable and girl named Quin.

title: Zup! Arena
description: Zup! Arena is a multiplayer arcade game in which you have to fight with other players! Throw off all your opponents from the battlefield and become the "King of the mountain". Play alone or in a group with friends!

title: I Wanna Be the Creator
description: Creation, challenge! You can be a demonic level creator, or a fearless checkpoint challenger, creating and sharing your level and bringing in more players!

title: Aim Master
description: Aim Master is aim-trainer, especially for PUBG. Aim Master has the same mouse sensitivity system and very similar recoil patterns with PUBG. It surely will improve your aiming skill for PUBG.

title: Nuclear Rancher
description: Atomic Rancher is a nuclear-fueled farming RPG that encourages players to grow, collect, and mutate their crops in order to grow and develop their town. Explore a vast and ruined world brimming with mystery and adventure. Will you thrive or only barely survive?

title: Dreamwalker: Never Fall Asleep
description: In a small tourist town a young girl, the daughter of the town’s mayor, falls in coma due to an accident. The impotence of the local physicians forces Mrs. Mayor to seek the aid of a psychiatrist, who is rumoured to possess a unique ability to traverse people’s dreams – a Dreamwalker.

title: Survival Ball
description:
Single / Local Co-Op PC game with six distinct stages developing a simple premise: As the decaying world challenges you, don't fall! 
 
- Single and Local Co-Op modes 
- Six distinct stages and mechanics 
- Move, Jump, Dash and Stomp are your tools to skillfully confront enemies, help your teammates and interact with the world. 
- Launching for Windows and MacOS on November 8th, 2018 (Steam)

title: Blixten Quest
description: Come and join now! Loots, craft and big world to explore! Adventure is fun right? The game is adding more features every Major update!

title: Island Maze
description: Beautiful and interesting isometric game, created specially for lovers of the mind-bending puzzles.

title: A Game About
description: A Game About is a free, short, lo-fi point & click adventure that tasks the player with living with their daily routine. Through day to day choices, life changes in imperceptibles and unexpected ways.

title: PixelRPG
description: Travel across a pixelated game world and capture and evolve monsters along the way.

title: Wish Giver
description: Wish Giver is a role playing game for solving puzzles. The game tells us that the protagonist, as a new wish giver, has received very challenging entrustment due to huge rewards.But the road to fulfill the wish of the aspirant is far more complicated than she imagined.

title: Monkeys & Dragons
description: Jack and Lana just started their honeymoon, when Jack was kidnapped by a sorcerer. Lana decides to take matters into her own hands. She becomes an adventurer, completes quests and solves dangerous puzzles. However, there was something she wasn't prepared for...

title: Cubanoids
description: Cubanoids is a hardcore, cooperative, ultra fast, infinite play arena-based shooter providing an exceptional close-quarter battlefield experience.

title: Monster Safari
description: Look at all these adorable monsters. I'm sure they'll make you happy if you raise them right! Oh, remember to keep an eye on their mood... they get destructive when they aren't happy! Don't forget to ensure the safety of your guests and staff. Come on in and start your park in Monster Safari! Everyone is counting on you! Rah rahrah!

title: AreaZ
description: AreaZ game is true survival simulation, where player has to rely on his knowledge and survival skills in different bioms or so called area(z). Starting on beach and jungle area(z) until player conquers the deadly swamp. Future game will include Rural mainland, Forrest and snow covered Mountains.

title: A Killer's Sorrow
description: What if you were the killer? Wouldn't that be a thrill? But what if you're being hunted by an evil greater than yourself? Will you run, hide,...or will you fight back?

title: Achtung die Kugel!
description: A local multiplayer game with skill and tactics! Score by being the last player to crash in each round. Achtung die Kugel is a re-imagination of the classic game "Achtung die Kurve".

title: Star Thief
description: Star Thief is an action-adventure game in which you play as a space bandit, in a galaxy that has lost all sense of justice and order

description: Play as an aspiring fashion designer with your own boutique and experience a heart pounding romance.

title: Combo Jumper
description: Combo Jumper is a first-person platformer. The core mechanic of the game is combo points. You gain a combo point every time you wall jump and each combo point multiplies how far you jump on the next wall however upon touching the ground your combo points get reset so to make a large jump you have to make consecutive wall jumps to make...

title: Candice DeBebe's Scandalous Secrets
description: Candice DeBebe's Scandalous Secrets is a magical action role playing game. The beautiful, multi-talented Candice DeBebe returns for the sequel to her minor hit, Candice DeBebe's Incredibly Trick Lifestyle.

title: Night Fallen
description: Night Fallen is an Open World, First-Person Action Horror Game with Stealth and RPG mechanics. Set in a small remote forest of the United Kingdom, a horde of other worldly have taken hold. It's time to fight back!

title: Xobox
description: New generation of tic-tac-toe game in VR and 3D. XoboX is an addictive noughts and crosses game enriched with an extra dimension that will draw you into long hours of play and fun for everyone in any age.

title: Seven days with the Ghost
description: Ayako is the only member of the Occult Research Club at girls-only Keisei Academy. Needing to attract more students or have her club shut down, she tries to seek out the "Seven Wonders of the Academy". What she finds is more than she bargained for. An occult yuri game created by members of 2ch!

title: Pumpkin Death Garden
description:
2D top-down arcade survival shooter, in which you grow and defend your pumpkin patch from bugs!

Get competitive on the leaderboard! Your score is the amount of bugs you killed.

Are you a shotgun person, a sniper rifle person, or an assault rifle person? Try them out to find your favourite.
Each has a unique play style with strengths and drawbacks!

When you level up, you are given a choice of three random gun mods. Sometimes you'll have to improvise, and work with whatever you get!

Earn coins when you play, and spend them on upgrades! Currently 40 upgrades available, with more planned for the next update!

There is no DLC, and no in-game purchases. You get the full game!

Want to sit back, relax, and shoot some bugs? Play the game on normal speed.

Looking for an intense challenge? Try the game on 1.5x speed, or even 2x speed!

W, A, S and D to move.

Use the mouse to aim, and left click to shoot.

Feel free to leave a review.

Enjoy!

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Space
description: If you like to make puzzles, Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Space is your game. Visit the infinite space enjoying its comfortable and intuitive interface and its relaxing music that will allow you to concentrate on the difficult task of solving these beautiful photos that suppose a real challenge for puzzle lovers.

title: Not Heaven
description: Not Heaven is an interactive world built as a platform for Wealthy Relative's 6 song rap EP with the same title. The game experience contains 6 music videos, multiple art galleries, god-like abilities, and more. Not Heaven is the first Rap record to be released as a video game.

title: Forsaken Realms: Vahrin's Call
description: Adventure awaits in this narrative driven fantasy action-RPG. The war-torn city of Vahrin stands before you on the brink of collapse and in desperate need of aid. As a mercenary in search of your next…opportunity, will you answer Vahrin’s Call?

title: Grand Strategy
description: Grand Strategy is a massive multiplayer game inspired by the board game RISK. You can play the game casually or in campaign mode where two factions fight for victory in one grand war, on one large overland map. The faction with the most victory points will emerge victorious.

title: Stikir
description: This game is about making this game.

title: Nice Shot! The Gun Golfing Game
description: Golf meets FPS in this unique twist on the beloved golf genre. Use a variety of guns and your skills & finesse to rack up bonus points and come in under par! But beware-- this is one golf game that won't hold your hand! Unlock courses and a secret gun in single player, or play against your friends in multiplayer!

title: Ho Tu Lo Shu: The Books of Dragon
description: Ho Tu Lo Shu: The Books of Dragon is the third title of Heluo Studio since its return to the PC game market with the game, Tale of Wuxia. It inherits the trademark feature of Heluo Studio, high degree of freedom for players, creating an wuxia style open world for the first time.

title: Go to It
description: Have you ever wanted to run your own software company? Go to IT is a business simulation game with a multitude of parameters to manage and meaningful choices to enjoy. Build your company and bring it to the top, surviving almost 30 years of software industry ups and downs.

title: Hot Girls VR
description: Welcome to the world full of beautiful, hot girls, meet them all, play with them at the party and... Do what you want. Everything depends on your imagination.

title: I'm an adventurer
description: Want to be an adventurer, but the reality is not so simple. If you can't become an adventurer, why not to be the boss of the adventurers! Set up an Adventurer's guild! chatting, hiring, solving quest, making adventurers stronger.

title: The Masked Mage
description: The Masked Mage is a metroidvania game focusing on exploration, atmosphere and a story about friendship, mystery and of course magic.

title: Gravity Spin
description: Gravity Spin is a metroidvania with a literal spin.

title: Quiver Dick's Terrible Tale for Terrible Parents to Read to Their Equally Terrible Children
description: From the creative minds that brought you Metal as Phuk and The Chronicles of Quiver Dick, Crankage Games brings you another hilarious, boner-inducing tale of epic proportions! Embark on a journey as Mary the Fairy, a cannibalistic, foul-mouthed pixie in an even more foul-mouthed world!

title: War Dust
description: With 64 soldiers on the battlefield, War Dust will take you into the largest online battles that have ever been made in VR featuring a huge arsenal of guns and vehicles. Solidarity, rivalry, cooperation, confrontation: enjoy virtual reality from a new perspective.

title: The Hour Has Come
description: You wake up in a seemingly empty mansion with only one goal... Escape. As you lurk through the shadows of the halls and corridors, something else is following your footsteps. Will you make it out alive? Or will this nightmare become a reality?

title: Light Up the Holidays
description: Decorate a variety of houses and other buildings in Christmas lights of any size and colour and then sync them to music. Spice up your environments with holiday props to create a stunning winter scene that can also be used as a live desktop wallpaper.

title: The Horologist's Legacy
description: The Horologist's Legacy is a deep dive into the absurd to find your mysterious past in this indie first-person psychological horror experience that rips the floor out from under you and takes your mind places you've never brought it before.

title: Intelligence: Underwater Kingdom
description: Is a puzzle game in which you want to build an image (with the animals of the underwater Kingdom) so that the picture was like the original image. Move the tiles of the puzzle wisely to collect the correct order of the pieces of images.

title: 1971: Indian Naval Front
description: Learn about the biggest naval conflict since WWII. Third-person vehicular combat game based on 1971 India-Pakistan war. Conduct missions based on actual events. Control naval units including aircraft carriers, warships, jets and choppers. Crack morse coded messages and progress through levels.

title: Inkulinati
description: Inkulinati is an ink-based strategy straight from medieval manuscripts, where a rabbit’s bum can be deadlier than a dog's sword. Become a master of the Living Ink, build your own bestiary, defeat medieval superstars and collect perks to unleash hidden powers.

title: A Front Too Far: Normandy
description: World War II: Fight in enemy territory, take care of every single bullet, medicine, tuna can in this exciting RPG adventure with a solid plot and totally innovative mechanics!

title: Super Turbo Sudoku
description: Welcome to "Super Turbo Sudoku", a game not about love, trust, hope or bravery, but about solving Sudokus. No matter if you prefer to just relax solving easy riddles or if you want to prove yourself with insane challenges, this game has it all!

title: Battle X Arcade
description: Battle X Arcade is an arcade version of Battle X, which is specifically developed for LBE(Location Based Entertainment) venues

title: Ar-K: End Game
description: Ar-K: End Game is the final episode in the classic point and click saga of AR-K. Help Alicia Van Volish to escape from District 8 and discover the source of the mysterious Golden Sphere through a great story...

title: Pang & Bang
description: Pang and Bang is a tribute to the old "pop the bubbles" games that you could find in the arcades, but with an erotic twist.

title: Dandy & Randy
description: Dandy and Randy is a 2D top-down old-school arcade game featuring two of the worst archaeologists to ever grace the Earth. Help them in their adventures by finding treasure defeating enemies, fighting bosses and discovering secrets! Can they pay off their debts? It's up to you to find out!

title: Ecchi Memory Game
description: Test your memory skills and unlock enticing images in Ecchi Memory Game, the ultimate adult-themed memory challenge! This isn't your grandma's memory game; get ready for a captivating experience featuring beautiful and seductive anime art. Sharpen your mind and indulge your senses with every successful match.

description: Hello and welcome to Yuna World. Help Yuna collect candy hearts and accompany her through the day. Candy hearts are an important currency in the world of Yuna. Get to know her better privately, maybe you will like each other. You like collecting achievements? You've come to the right place.

title: Distress: A Choice-Driven Sci-Fi Adventure
description: A sci-fi visual novel where the lives of your crew are in your hands. Investigate a mysterious space station. Make your choices, live with the consequences.

title: Nanoswarm
description: Nanoswarm is a game about surviving an endless assault from an army of nanobots with the ability to form terrifying and unstoppable battlebots. You're not alone though. Tank command is back at base finding you new powerups all the time, helping you to overcome the odds and have a chance against your terrible foe.

title: Fairy Tale Diaries
description: Become the godfather of the medieval world. You are a simple huntsman living in the legendary kingdom of Asteria, a land ruled by a tyrannical Queen and her daughter. With the help of a few trusted men and the tight grip of your sword you build up a powerful outlaw group based in the center of Asteria.

title: Guns 'n Guts
description: Guns 'n Guts is a fast-paced, top-down shooter filled with action and gore. Blast your way through hundreds of hellish enemies in challenging skill-based combat. Can you survive?

title: Data mining 2
description: Data Mining 2 - casual colorful minimalist puzzle in which you have to collect all the files that are not corrupted to exit the closed circle.

title: Down to Hell
description: Down to hell is a dynamic slasher in which lone swordsman must face the hordes of hellish demons. Moreover Down to Hell will give you truly Heavy F’N Metal experience.

description: Xenochamber is a platformer with a paradoxical storyline. You play as Jill who is searching for her father in an unexplored planetary system.

description: Puzzles for Smart: Birds - for fans of popular puzzles of different complexity. Collect puzzle with the image of these beautiful birds.

description:
The Iris School of Wizardry. A school where girls and boys blessed with intelligence, talent, and economic fortune gather.

The difficulty factor is said to be more than 300, but those who graduate are promised a sparkling future as elite members of every important institution in the country.

The protagonist' Aria's parents died when she was a child, she spent her days taking care of her parents old rare bookshop and wishing she could someday become a fine magician like her father was. Then one day a letter came to her.

It was permission to enroll into the academy.

description: F1 2018 is the official videogame of the 2018 FIA FORMULA ONE WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP. Become immersed in the world of Formula 1 more than ever before when F1 2018 releases.

Help Kimmie Jong On survive the labyrinths of the Artificial Sentient System, A.S.S., and achieve his goal of eliminating all the nuclear powers of the world.

Form your team of dark fantasy creatures and use their spells to destroy your opponent's shrine. Now it takes only two players to start a match.

description: Imagine that you have divine powers. What do you do? Help people or take the piss out of them? That's a priest's life.

description: Spiral Clicker is a clicker style game in which a mysterious elf with absolutely no ulterior motives whatsoever has given you access to a magical spiral that can drain your willpower and turn it into energy you can use to build your dream harem out of the girls at your local college.

description: Face off as the Zombie Soldier against the undead army. Explore graveyards and army bases to eradicate them all. Shoot, jump and destroy in this simple retro styled 2.5D metroidvania throwback game. A casual yet challenging introduction to the Zombie Soldier world.

Exploration and rescuing helpless survivors can bring you great rewards, and each you save unlocks a trainable ability you can unlock (up to 4 total) to help you survive deeper into...

title: Talk to Yuno
description: Chat with Yuno! Solve cases, input keywords, or simply check in to see how she's doing!
